steps.title: Stand it up
steps.instruction: Get a second person to help. Tip the KALLAX shelving unit 1×4 up onto its bottom edge, as the animation shows.
steps.warning: Fix it to the wall with the wall fitting before you use it. Furniture that tips over can injure people.
checklist: It stands level on all corners
It is fixed to the wall
